description: Output of the Questmaster (Muse Spark): an ordered, energy-sized cleanup quest built from a Room Inventory.

card_text.description: Text for the shareable before/after card, e.g. '47 items · 23 minutes · 1 room reclaimed'

rescan_prompt.description: Asks for the after photo; progress is proven by re-segmentation diff, not self-report

energy_level.description: User-declared energy budget; the plan must fit inside it, never exceed it

intro_line.description: One warm, zero-shame line from the Questmaster. Never comments negatively on the mess.

is_boss.description: True for the largest zone: the Boss Battle, health bar = live item count from re-scans

instruction.description: One physical action, completable in under ~2 minutes. Trash first, then categories, surfaces last.

is_mystery_box.description: True when the step resolves low-confidence/unknown items: 'open it, sort what you find'

item_refs.description: Inventory instance ids this step clears

reroute_rule.description: No-shame re-route: any skipped step is silently re-planned around; the quest never scolds, never breaks a streak.

title: TidyQuest Quest Plan
